visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short black hair, wearing a white shirt and a purple apron over it, is seated in a brightly lit dining area. She holds a small brown honey bottle and carefully pours a golden liquid into a ceramic bowl of soup. (2) A close-up shot reveals the contents of the bowl: translucent white fungus and orange-yellow fruit chunks floating in a clear liquid. A white teapot and wooden spoon rest in the blurred background on a wooden tray. (3) Hands rinse a large, white, fresh tremella fungus under running water in a metal mesh strainer. (4) In a modern kitchen with pink cabinetry and white shelving, the woman uses red-handled scissors to snip the white fungus into small pieces directly into a white ceramic pot. (5) She pours water from a metal container into the pot, covering the fungus pieces. (6) Six red dates are shown in a small bowl of water; she then uses the scissors to cut the dates open and remove the pits, dropping the fruit into the boiling pot. (7) A pink ladle stirs the boiling white fungus mixture, and then she places a heavy white lid on the pot to simmer. (8) On a bright yellow cutting board, the woman peels a firm orange persimmon with a handheld peeler and then slices it into small triangular chunks. (9) She opens the pot to show the thickened, slightly pinkish liquid, then adds rock sugar from a small wooden bowl and stirs. (10) Dried yellow osmanthus flowers are added from a patterned bowl into the pot, followed by the persimmon chunks. (11) Finally, back in the seated position, the woman adds more honey to her individual bowl, tastes a spoonful with a smile, and waves goodbye as text overlays appear.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 這樣煮好好吃. [Slogan]: 桂花香木耳露. [Subtitle]: 加上柿子更對味! ❤️. (2) [Subtitle]: 準備一朵新鮮的白木耳. 先清洗乾淨. (3) [Subtitle]: 瀝乾水分. (4) [Subtitle]: 將白木耳用剪刀 剪成小碎片. 如果使用乾燥的白木耳 要先冰箱泡開一個晚上... 建議買新鮮的 比較好吃! (5) [Subtitle]: 加入大約 1400~1500ml的冷水. (6) [Subtitle]: 開中火加熱. (7) [Subtitle]: 冷凍的紅棗洗乾淨 泡一下熱水.. 可以簡單用剪刀將 紅棗前後剪開. 果核的兩側用剪刀 各剪開一刀. 果核底部剪開一刀 就可以用剪刀挖出來了. 真的很簡單 不需要找什麼吸管... (8) [Subtitle]: 慢慢的煮滾... 滾了之後轉小火... 蓋上鍋蓋 燉煮15~20分鐘... (9) [Subtitle]: 每次都放水梨... 這次我想要在木耳露裡面 放入柿子...(硬柿). 柿子有潤肺、生津止咳的作用 也很適合放在木耳露裡喔. 柿性涼，加熱可以緩和涼性. 搭配紅棗煮成甜湯 也會比較溫和喔! 把柿子切成小塊狀備用. (10) [Subtitle]: 好囉 時間到~開蓋! 現在木耳露 已經開始稠稠的了. 這時候比較容易噗鍋. 開蓋用小滾的方式 再煮個10分鐘左右. 煮到你喜歡的稠度. (11) [Subtitle]: 最後放入60~80克的 冰糖調味. 攪拌到冰糖溶解 基礎的木耳露就完成了! (12) [Variety]: 升級版的. [Slogan]: 桂花香木耳露! ❤️. [Subtitle]: 準備3克的桂花 直接放入木耳露裡煮. 大蓋煮個5分鐘 讓桂花融合在木耳露裡. 漸漸的桂花 就會跟湯頭融合了. 桂花也不能煮太久 香味會流失喔! (13) [Subtitle]: 最後兩分鐘 放入柿子... 柿子不要煮太久 會太軟... 因為水果有酵素 產生泡泡是正常的喔! (可以撈掉...). (14) [Subtitle]: 超級好喝又簡單的 桂花香木耳露就完成啦~ ❤️. (15) [Subtitle]: 煮好後可以再加入 蜂蜜會更好喝! 嗯~好香的桂花香.... 那我要開動囉 ~ ❤️. 好好喝喔❤️ 這是我喝過 最好喝的木耳露了! ~ ❤️. 柿子也很好吃❤️. (16) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video alternates between a bright dining area with a wooden table and a view of a window with white curtains, and a modern kitchen featuring pink bottom cabinets, white tiled walls with patterns, and shelves stocked with cooking equipment like an espresso machine.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Gentle acoustic guitar and light percussion music start. A calm, friendly female voice begins narrating the recipe steps over the melody. (2) A clear splashing sound occurs as the fungus is rinsed in water. (3) Rhythmic metallic snipping sounds are heard as the woman cuts the white fungus. The narrator's voice maintains a steady, explanatory pace. (4) A hollow, splashing sound follows as water is poured into the ceramic pot. (5) Metallic clicks and thuds accompany the cutting and pitting of the red dates. The background music remains constant in volume and tempo. (6) A distinct bubbling sound and the light clatter of a lid being placed on a pot occur. (7) Sharp slicing and scraping sounds follow as the persimmon is prepared on a cutting board. (8) A soft whoosh of steam is heard when the pot is opened, followed by the wet, viscous sound of the pink ladle stirring the thickening soup. (9) The sound of small rock sugar pieces clattering into the pot is heard. (10) A faint rustling sound accompanies the addition of dried osmanthus flowers. (11) Gentle splashes are heard as fruit chunks are added to the liquid. (12) A soft plastic squeeze and dripping sound mark the addition of honey. The narrator concludes with high-pitched, enthusiastic sounds of tasting and satisfaction.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Step-by-Step Preparation -> Final Product Tasting -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an educational cooking tutorial for a traditional healthy dessert (Osmanthus White Fungus Soup with Persimmon). It aims to demonstrate the simplicity of the recipe while highlighting the health benefits of the ingredients and the creator's personal brand.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display of LE CREUSET cookware and the creator's own social media handles.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses clear, high-quality audio and a very consistent visual style to build trust. The use of hand-drawn-style emojis and warm lighting creates a cozy, lifestyle-oriented atmosphere typical of high-end cooking vlogs.
